summary: Shows passing extra vars as JSON strings, including lists, and notes quotes and special characters must be escaped for both JSON and the shell.
questions: How do I pass a list as an extra var?
How do I pass JSON to --extra-vars?
How do I escape quotes in extra vars?

answer_card.title: JSON extra vars
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
ansible-playbook release.yml --extra-vars '{"version":"1.23.45","other_variable":"foo"}'
ansible-playbook arcade.yml --extra-vars '{"pacman":"mrs","ghosts":["inky","pinky","clyde","sue"]}'
```

Escape quotes and special characters for both JSON and your shell (e.g. names with apostrophes need careful quoting).
